title: queue list
description: What <app> queue answers with -o json: the tickets of one served thing in the order they go, and the files moved to .queue/bad/. A person or script sees what waits, whose turn it is, and what was skipped (ADR-S14).

kind.description: Always QueueList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: One served thing's queue: its line and its skipped files.

tickets.description: The tickets in the order their changes run, first the one whose turn it is, so a reader sees what goes before its own change.

items.description: One ticket and its place in the line.

ticket.description: The ticket as it is on disk (queue-ticket.schema.json), so a reader reads the answer and the file by the same schema.

turn.description: Its change runs now. Only the first ticket can hold the turn.

since.description: When the change that runs now took the turn; only on the place whose turn it is. A person sees how long it has run; other processes never judge a holder by it, since each process limits its own change.

bad.description: Stale or unreadable tickets, skipped so the line keeps moving; a person looks at them and removes them.

file.description: The file's name in .queue/bad/, so a person can find it there.
